name: ws-marketplace
description: WS Agency internal plugins, agents, and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: docs-agent
plugins.description: Dual-track documentation suite with unified /ws-docs entry (discovery, init, audit, catchup, repair, write, adr, architecture, contributing, changelog, release-notes), opt-in PreToolUse/Stop hooks, and background subagent dispatch

plugins.name: ws-commit-commands
plugins.description: Jira-aware git workflows via jira-cli: Conventional Commits with ticket suffix, worklogs and transitions, ticket writing (/ws-ticket), automatic Keep-a-Changelog updates, and PR creation via tea (Gitea)

plugins.name: ws-project-hub
plugins.description: Multi-repo project hub: single source of truth for projects spanning multiple git repos (app, web, design, docs) with auto-generated CLAUDE.md and Claude launch script
